title: Spectral topological space
statement: A topological space $X$ is *spectral* if it is quasi-compact, quasi-separated (the intersection of two quasi-compact open subsets is quasi-compact), sober (every irreducible closed subset has a unique generic point), and the quasi-compact open subsets form a basis of the topology.
